# BUA Psykiatrisk Dagafsnit

BUA Psykiatrisk Dagafsnit is a psychiatric day unit named in Danish ADHD-treatment data covering the reporting period 01.04.2024-31.03.2025 [^src1]. The unit stands out in this dataset for reporting that 100 percent of its patients received ADHD medication within 120 days of treatment start, based on a reported figure with a range of 16-100 [^src1]. This places BUA Dagafsnit at the top end of a national picture that, according to the surrounding data, showed wide regional variation in medication timeliness — from 56 percent in Region Sjælland to 82 percent in Region Nordjylland — meaning the unit's reported 100 percent figure is notably higher than most regional averages captured in the same ADHD database.

The figures come from Denmark's ADHD database, which combines records from the national medicine-statistics database (lægemiddelstatistikdatabasen) and Statistics Denmark (Danmarks Statistik) to track indicator 6 (medication use within 120 days of treatment start) and indicators 7a/7b (educational outcomes for young people with ADHD). The same broader dataset flags concerning educational outcomes nationally, with only 53 percent of young people in the diagnostic-assessment population passing their lower-secondary school leaving exam, compared with 84 percent in the general population — context that frames why timely medication reporting, like BUA Dagafsnit's, is treated as a significant indicator in the underlying source document.

Beyond this single data point, no further relationships, claims, or timeline events are recorded for BUA Psykiatrisk Dagafsnit in the corpus. The entity is documented here strictly as it appears in the ADHD_2024.pdf tables.
